hypothesis: Separating current object localization from history/robot guides/negative feedback may recover accurate visible contact identification without copying an all-false example or preferring the active wrist.
sample_selection: One original initial search snapshot as absent-target control; all three predeclared H32 near-contact snapshots, no outcome-dependent replacements
input: Only the same3 CURRENT RAW images and exact current subgoal from each archived observation. No PREVIOUS/guide frames, geometry, old target answers, failure feedback or oracle input.
protocol: One localization call per state with short explicit neutral field specification. Unknown enclosure/co-motion/support/effect are forced null. Existing H33 refinement algorithm may add at most one surface query per state. No sample retries.
baseline: Reuse all4 archived H30 observations; H34 negative feedback result retained separately. This compound input intervention is not a causal ablation of each prompt component.
acceptance: Parent manually checks all4 states/RAW and new UV/surface proposals, including absent control; requires no bad table point accepted. Static localization only, not grasp or physical SR.
